item.title: When You Don’t Notice What’s Missing Until It’s Gone
item.description: A seemingly minor travel mishap of a forgotten suitcase reveals profound spiritual lessons about mistaking control for peace and finding God's presence even in loss. Discover how life's unexpected detours can clarify what truly matters and deepen your trust in divine guidance.

item.title: How to Love Like Christ When the World Feels Divided
item.description: Discover how to embody Christ's transformative love in today's divided world by embracing humility and speaking truth with grace, mirroring Jesus' powerful example. Learn to extend the same invitation to freedom and restoration that He offered, transforming interactions and relationships.

item.title: February A Month of Prayer
item.description: This February, transform your prayer life into a consistent and meaningful practice by creating a personalized prayer calendar. Discover simple yet powerful methods to set intentions, choose formats, and incorporate scripture for a more focused and fulfilling spiritual journey.

item.title: A Prayer to Guard Your Heart - Your Daily Prayer - February 10
item.description: Compassion is a gift, but empathy without boundaries can leave your heart weary. This prayer offers strength to love others without losing yourself.
